instruction: Delete all files in the "/tmp/test_files" directory that were last modified 30 days ago

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

result.command: bash -c 'OLD_COUNT=$(find /tmp/test_files/old_files -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l); NEW_COUNT=$(find /tmp/test_files/new_files -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l); if [ "$OLD_COUNT" -eq 0 ] && [ "$NEW_COUNT" -eq 2 ]; then echo "Success: Old files deleted, new files preserved"; else echo "Fail: OLD_COUNT=$OLD_COUNT NEW_COUNT=$NEW_COUNT"; fi'

include: Success: Old files deleted, new files preserved

metadata.explanation: Task requires deleting files modified 30 days ago while preserving newer files. Verification checks that old_files directory has 0 files and new_files directory has 2 files. Uses existing check_include_exclude metric with vm_command_line getter.
